gap_classification.notes: Official India site firstrand.co.in is reachable (HTTP 200) but FirstRand Bank India is a corporate & investment bank (Indo-African corridor) with no retail/term-deposit product. The India branch license is being wound down to a representative office and all Savings/Current/NRI customer accounts are being migrated to HDFC Bank. No deposit interest-rate page exists.
